notes.title: CRYSTORLD Soundtrack has been discontinued.
notes.notes: [p]CRYSTORLD Soundtrack has been discontinued.[/p][p]It will no longer be available for new purchase. However, if you have already purchased it, you can still download and use it.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding.[/p]

notes.title: Crystorld Soundtrack release suspension announcement
notes.notes: [p]The Crystorld Soundtrack is currently on sale on Steam, but due to various circumstances, we are in the process of removing it from the Steam market.[/p][p]I will contact you again once we have decided to remove it.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding.[/p]
